ticket_text: I can't connect to the office VPN since this morning.
root_cause: The user's machine appears to be blocked from reaching the VPN endpoint (`vpn.corporate.com`) due to an issue with the network allow-list.
fix: Please contact the network administration team to ensure your workstation's IP address or credentials have been added to the corporate VPN allow-list, as the network diagnostic check indicates the host is currently unreachable.
